summary: Steep residential kerb with houses 4-10 m away along most of it.
reasons: Dwellings within 10 m for most of it

best_section.where: top of Coverdale Street, east kerb at the start

drivers.seclusion: Houses 4-10 m from the kerb from 12 m onwards; even the top end has a house 16 m away and others across the road.
drivers.access_and_room: Narrow sealed street with cars parked on the west side; little room on the east.
drivers.convention: Residents park on the street, but this side is lined with homes.

flags: Steep: about 14.5% mean grade, over the 12% limit
sun_shade: Heavy tree shade over the upper part; open lower down.
